attributes.action: Allow the sale of raw milk in Scotland
attributes.background: Calling on the UK Government to work with the Scottish Government to repeal Schedule 6 of the Food Hygiene (Scotland) Regulations 2006, legalising the direct-to-consumer sale of unpasteurised raw milk and cream in Scotland to ensure equal food rights across all UK nations.

rejection.details:
This is a matter that falls entirely under Scottish Government jurisdiction - you may wish to petition the Scottish Government about this at the Scottish Parliament website:

https://petitions.parliament.scot/
